## About
Allied Body & Frame is the auto body shop on San Pablo Avenue in Berkeley. Whether you need full collision repair, refinishing or anything in between, we're here to guide you through the process every step of the way.
Peter Brisbo managed the shop before he became the owner, and the same core team has been working alongside him ever since. Our customers are also our neighbors, and we proudly stand by all of our work.
Customers rate us 4.9 from 32 reviews on Google, and Checkbook.org rated us one of the top auto body shops in the Bay Area.

## Services
- Full collision repair: From minor damage to major repairs on Asian, European and domestic cars, with help through the process every step of the way.
- Refinishing services: Paint and refinishing work done so the repair matches the rest of your car.
- Insurance negotiations: We have expertise in dealing with insurance negotiations and can help you through them.
- AAA Direct Repair Facility: We're a provider in the AAA Direct Repair Network and communicate electronically with AAA to move claims along.
- Pick-up and return service: Ask us about having your car picked up and returned.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: A wide range, including Asian, European and domestic cars.

Q: Can you help me deal with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We assist with communication and protocol with insurance companies, as needed.

Q: Do you work with AAA?
A: Yes. We're a AAA Direct Repair Facility. We use digital imagery and communicate electronically with AAA, which speeds up claims.

Q: Can I get a rental car while mine is in the shop?
A: A rental car facility is within walking distance of the shop.
